<!-- pr-reviewer: ceb25ebf5a169a33d2edb30b0cce5fa05da000cd -->
**Verdict: clean on its own commit (no blockers), but STACKED: it must merge after #1319.** Not offered as `merge-ready` while its parent is unmerged.

Reviewed at the safety-floor standard (verify / gouge-check logic). Judged only the last commit, `ceb25ebf` ("the mid-turn overhang backstop reads the whole turn"); the first commit is #1319's and is reviewed there. Reviewer is not the author's session; this counts under PROCESS_VERSION 32.

**What looks good**
- The backstop now reads the same reachable set as #1313's column law (`turn_hidden.rs:74-119`): cells split so sag <= 0.05 mm, capped at 20 intervals, grouped into <= 4 tip-chord runs. Past the cap the cells only grow, so the error is on the convicting side.
- Fail-closed paths kept: `hidden_in_cover` returns `true` when the slice fails (`hidden.rs` `Err(()) => return true`), and a non-finite box returns false only because the NonFinite law already names it.
- The kerf is the same `kerf2 = (r + gouge_tol)^2` as the column law (`sweep.rs:177,203`), and `Cell::bottom_over` is unchanged, so the tip's kerf is excused only where the tip stands.
- The backstop still runs only when the column law found nothing, so it adds convictions and never removes one.
- Slice budget unchanged (<= 20 planes per live band); pinned by `a_move_asks_at_most_twenty_planes_per_band`, including NaN letters. No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` added; indexing goes through `get_mut` with a `#[cold]` fallback. Provenance lines present; every touched file is under ~400 lines.
- Old `backstop_columns` / `path_point` / the 4 x 5 grid are removed, not left dead.

**Local results** (trial-merged with upstream/main d007f407, clean merge, no conflicts; #1319's commit comes along as expected, `mergeable: MERGEABLE`)
| check | result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-sim --lib` | 110 passed |
| sim `midturn_hidden_backstop` | 3 passed |
| sim `midturn_swept_band` | 2 passed |
| sim `overhang_laws` | 13 passed |
| sim verify-touching suites (axis_door, boundary_arc_*, c_axis_fixture, coarse_collision, crossing_*, fixture_*, midmove_pose, model_excess, posed_*, prior_columns, radial/sideways/vertical rapids, tilt_tolerance, hidden_rest_banded, wall_slack; 25 binaries) | all green, 0 failed |
| app `golden_cl` | 26 passed |
| app `solid_law`, `solid_law_goldens`, `coarse_laws`, `verify_arc_reading` | 4 / 6 / 6 / 7 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Mutation check.** Restored the parent commit's `sweep.rs` and `reach.rs` (the 4 x 5 grid backstop) and un-registered `turn_hidden`: `a_holder_crossing_hidden_stock_between_two_sampled_poses_is_convicted` goes red (`midturn_hidden_backstop.rs:85`, left `[]`, right `[SweepHit { at: 0, part: false }]`) while both clean twins stay green. With the fix restored it is green again. So the pin fails on the old path and the "reads the whole turn" claim holds for that fixture.

**Requested before merge**
None for this commit. Process condition only: merge #1319 first (retarget this PR to `main` first, per the stacking law), then take `git merge origin/main`, re-gate and re-check.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
1. Each ask is judged at the lowest bottom any cell of its (interval, run) reaches (`turn_hidden.rs:92-113`, `Cell::floor`). A cell whose own bottom is higher than that plane is tested against hidden stock below it, so false convictions are possible where the old per-column plane would not have asked there. It is on the safe side, but the PR's "Not exercised" list is right that false-conviction rate on large posed programs is unmeasured; worth a look in the release lane.
2. `hidden_in_cover` still reads the hidden region by its own 0.5 mm XY samples plus the footprint probes (24-point rings, 5 stations). A hidden pocket narrower than that spacing that sits between probes and between boundary samples is a pre-existing limit, as the PR says; not widened here.
3. `cell_count` is now `#[cfg(test)]` only; fine.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
